youtube.title: Persia beat Egypt by painting CATS on their shields 🐈 #shorts
youtube.caption:
Ancient Egyptians loved cats so much it cost them a war 😾

Comment the reply YOU would've sent 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on history: at the Battle of Pelusium in 525 BC, the Persian king Cambyses II is said to have put cats and images of cats in front of his army. Cats were sacred in Egypt and harming one was a serious crime, so the Egyptians hesitated, and Persia conquered Egypt.
